overview: Palau is an island country in the western Pacific, made up of about 340 islands. Its capital is Ngerulmud, and its largest town is Koror. Palau became independent in 1994 and has a close association with the United States. In 2009 it created the world's first shark sanctuary.

geography.text: Palau has volcanic islands, such as Babeldaob, the largest, and many limestone islands. The Rock Islands, small mushroom-shaped islands covered in forest, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its coral reefs and clear water make it one of the best places in the world for diving.
